snippet.title: Digimon Story Time Stranger – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Digimon Story Time Stranger launches July 10, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch. Pre-order today: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/digimon-story-time-stranger-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
 
Journey once more across time and space with the Digital World: Iliad at your fingertips in this turn-based RPG, where you work with 450+ Digimon to save the future.

With Nintendo Switch 2, you can select Quality Mode, playing in 4K at 30 frames per second, or Performance Mode, playing in full HD at 60 frames per second.
 
Pre-order today to receive two Digimon and a costume set—Agumon (Black), Gabumon (Black), and the Uniform of a Certain School!
 
The Deluxe Edition includes the base game, plus Costume: Cyber Sleuth Set and the Season Pass featuring 3 DLC releases.

The Ultimate Edition includes Early Unlock for a special Agumon and special Gabumon with their Digivolution conditions already unlocked. It’s the fastest way to get your hands on Agumon (Bond of Bravery) and Gabumon (Bond of Friendship)!

Packed with a Season Pass, special costumes, bonus items, and a nostalgic Cyber Sleuth BGM Pack, this is the definitive way to experience your Digimon adventure.

#DigimonStoryTimeStranger #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
